decisions.decision: Cherry-pick approach: applied files from beta directly (git checkout beta -- <file>) rather than cherry-picking individual commits
decisions.rationale: Many beta commits had wolf files mixed in. Direct file apply avoids cherry-pick conflicts and wolf-file bleed.

decisions.decision: Used rebase/cherry-pick workflow to keep main history linear, not merge
decisions.rationale: User preference for smooth linear history on main.

decisions.decision: Kept beta README over remote main's 7 docs commits (--theirs during cherry-pick conflict)
decisions.rationale: Beta README is canonical — correct install instructions, badges, no eval pattern. Remote docs had wrong install pattern (eval qq init zsh instead of >>).

decisions.decision: Version bumped to v0.2.0, not v0.1.1
decisions.rationale: feat: commit type correctly triggers minor bump. qq init is a new command, not a bugfix. v0.2.0 is semantically accurate.

decisions.decision: Dev vs Homebrew distinction via QQ_DEV_ROOT env var
decisions.rationale: Shell widget checks QQ_DEV_ROOT at trigger time — if set, uses local node build; if unset, uses installed qq binary. Toggle per session, no reinstall needed.
